content.description: Exploded view diagram showing brake booster assembly components including master cylinder with reservoir, brake booster, gaskets, clip, clevis pin, and hose. Non-reusable parts are marked with diamond symbols.

items:
REMOVE CLEVIS PIN FROM BRAKE PEDAL
Remove the clip and clevis pin.

REMOVE BRAKE BOOSTER
Remove the four nuts, and pull out the brake booster.

content.description: Detail illustration showing the clevis pin and clip connection at the brake pedal

items:
ADJUST LENGTH OF BOOSTER PUSH ROD
Adjust the length of the booster push rod to provide the specified clearance between the push rod and the master cylinder piston.
Standard clearance:    0.1 — 0.5 mm
                       (0.004 — 0.020 in.)

content.description: Cross-section diagram showing the clearance measurement between booster push rod and master cylinder piston
